authority: Local production contract for the Character Factory; documentation in docs/ARTISTIC_QUALITY_GATES.md. Not a Unity implementation and not an artistic approval.
scope: Any character/animation package presented as ready: technical completeness plus visual/artistic review before delivery.
visualReviewSurfaces: Biblioteca de Arte/Estudos Comparativos/Orc principal - Biblioteca completa/index.html

statusTaxonomy.progressionMeaning: The normal path. Each step requires the previous one: approval requires a visual review, a visual review requires technical completeness.
statusTaxonomy.blockingRule: ARTISTIC_REVISION_REQUIRED overrides every other label while the defect is open. A package can never be shown as VISUAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED, and never as CREATOR_APPROVED, while a known artistic defect is unresolved.

TECHNICALLY_COMPLETE.definition: Dimensions, groundY, binary alpha, hashes, Aseprite masters and frame counts pass automated checks.
TECHNICALLY_COMPLETE.implies: The package exists, is reproducible and is internally consistent.

VISUAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED.definition: Technically complete and free of the automated artistic-defect gates below, awaiting human visual inspection in the interactive review studio.
VISUAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED.implies: Ready for the creator to inspect; defects would be news, not a rework of known problems.
VISUAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED.canBeSetBy: DEV after the gates in this contract pass, or by the orchestrator

ARTISTIC_REVISION_REQUIRED.definition: Creator or visual QA identified anatomy, perspective, silhouette, choreography or pixel-cleanup defects that require revision.
ARTISTIC_REVISION_REQUIRED.implies: Do not present, promote or export as ready. Must name the action, direction and frame range.
ARTISTIC_REVISION_REQUIRED.canBeSetBy: creator, independent visual QA, or DEV with measured evidence

CREATOR_APPROVED.definition: Explicit artistic sign-off granted by the creator after visual inspection.
CREATOR_APPROVED.implies: Only the creator can grant it, per package and per recorded evidence. Never inferred from passing tests.
requires: explicit creator statement recorded with date and scope

forbiddenLabels: READY (without a status from this taxonomy)
DONE (for art that no human inspected)
APPROVED (when granted by tooling or by an agent)

directionalViewGate.principle: A rear view is a construction, not a repaint of a front sprite.
directionalViewGate.forbiddenShortcut: Deriving a back view by painting over the face (or by erasing facial features) on a front sprite. If the skull, nape and dorsal armor were not rebuilt, the view fails regardless of surface polish.
requiredRearMarkers: occipital skull with no face, brow, nose, mouth, tusks or eye sockets
nape and trapezius visible between skull and collar
rear high collar/gorget, open to the back
dorsal backplate with a central spine channel
scapula plates instead of pectoral plates or chest scars
rear belt/sash closure, without the front sternum peak
rear split tassets and rear chainmail fall
popliteal knee straps and calf greaves
boot heels and toes angled away from the viewer

distinctness.reason: A mirror flips the light source to the top-right and swaps the near shoulder, which the camera and the light do not do.

measurableChecks.noFrontFacePixels: The head region of a rear view must contain zero pixels from the front face palette (eyes, tusks, mouth).
measurableChecks.markerPresence: Every requiredRearMarkers entry must be identifiable in at least the Idle frames of that view.
measurableChecks.mirrorDependence: Compare back_r against horizontally flipped back_l. Pixel agreement above 97% indicates a mirrored copy rather than a constructed view.
measurableChecks.lightingSide: The highlight centroid must sit above the body centroid and on a consistent horizontal side across all four views.

choreographyGate.principle: An action must communicate its meaning in silhouette and timing, not only in shading.

hit.forbidden: A subtle 1-2px tremor presented as a damage reaction; breathing-like motion sold as impact.

measurableChecks.heightCompressionDefinition: Max standing height across the clip/Idle rest minus minimum compressed height during impact recoil (max(h) - min(h)).
measurableChecks.motionEnergyDefinition: Time-normalized inter-frame changed-pixel rate (changedPixelPct / frameDurationMs) in the torso and head bands, divided by the same time-normalized rate measured on the Idle clip of the same direction.

defeat.forbidden: Global 2D rotation of a standing sprite combined with vertical squashing (for example vScale = 0.52). A squashed standing pose is not a collapse.
requiredPreservation: contact on the ground line (groundY) in every frame

measurableChecks.maxSingleStageHeightDropRatioMeaning: No single transition may remove more than 35% of the standing height; a collapse that erases the torso in one step is a flatten, not a collapse.
measurableChecks.volumeRetention: Terminal frame keeps readable head, pauldron and chest masses; a silhouette reduced to a horizontal strip fails.

requirements: dark INK outline around the head crown
palette-accurate green skin border inside the outline
zero light-grey or white anti-aliasing halo pixels around the crown
stabilized head-top trajectory across the clip

measurableChecks.haloThreshold: min(R,G,B) >= 90 with |R-G| <= 10 and |G-B| <= 16 on the 4-neighborhood boundary of green skull pixels in y = 68..83, x = 116..149 of the 256x256 composite
measurableChecks.headBand: y = 68..83, x = 116..149 (green skull dome above the brow/eye line in the 256 composite)
measurableChecks.maxConsecutiveReversalPxMeaning: The head-top trajectory may rise and fall with the action, but an isolated reversal larger than 5px indicates jitter rather than intent.

completeSetReviewContract.principle: Review the set as a set. A single beautiful direction does not carry a library.
studioRequirements: all 4 directions x 7 actions reachable in one click from a single page
step-by-frame, play, speed control and zoom without leaving the page
before/after comparison for every revised action
transitions Idle -> Attack -> Idle, Walk -> Idle, Hit -> Idle and Defeat -> terminal pose
no smoothing, no invented frames, no interpolation in the preview

beforeAfterIntegrity.rule: A before/after comparison must come from the superseded build or the archived pre-revision frames.
beforeAfterIntegrity.check: If the 'before' image is byte-identical to the current output, the capture happened after the rewrite and the comparison is invalid.
beforeAfterIntegrity.lesson: Capture the before state before touching the pixels, then verify the hashes differ.

reviewerDuties: inspect anatomy, perspective, silhouette, cluster cleanliness and motion
state the action, direction and frame range of every defect
never report file counts or JSON schemas as artistic evidence

productionLessons.title: Technical completion is not artistic approval
productionLessons.rule: Hashes, canvas, groundY, alpha, frame counts and passing tests prove presence and consistency. They never prove that the art reads.
productionLessons.antiPattern: Declaring a set ready because validation returned 0 FAIL.

productionLessons.title: Back views require true rear-facing construction
productionLessons.rule: back_r and back_l must be built from the skull, nape, rearmost armor and rear belt outward. Painting over the face on a front sprite is forbidden.
productionLessons.antiPattern: Erasing eyes and tusks from a front frame and calling the result a rear view.

productionLessons.title: Directional coherence must hold across the entire animation set
productionLessons.rule: Idle, Walk, Unarmed, Sword, Axe, Hit and Defeat must agree on anatomy, perspective, lighting and armor construction in all four directions.
productionLessons.antiPattern: A correct back Idle followed by attacks whose rear plate disappears into a front chest plate.

productionLessons.title: Hit must communicate clear impact recoil
productionLessons.rule: Head snap, shoulder hunch, torso recoil and knee compression, measurably above idle breathing.
productionLessons.antiPattern: A 1-2px tremor with the same motion energy as Idle, labelled a damage reaction.

productionLessons.title: Defeat must be choreographed as a believable multi-stage collapse
productionLessons.rule: fatal-stagger -> knees-buckle -> drop-to-knees -> collapse-impact -> terminal-defeated, keeping head, pauldron and chest volume on the ground line.
productionLessons.antiPattern: Global 2D rotation plus vertical squash (vScale = 0.52) of a standing sprite, which flattens the character into a strip.

productionLessons.title: Local outline and head-stability artifacts must be fixed surgically
productionLessons.rule: Repair the halo, the stray pixel or the jitter in place, without breaking approved choreography, weapon sync, timing or identity.
productionLessons.antiPattern: Rebuilding an acceptable clip to remove six pixels, then losing the approved rhythm.

productionLessons.title: Preserve what already works when revising weak areas
productionLessons.rule: Frontal Idle, Walk and the frontal Sword/Axe attacks that were already approved stay byte-identical unless the creator asks otherwise.
productionLessons.antiPattern: Regenerating the whole library to fix the rear views, silently changing approved frontal art.

productionLessons.title: Review surfaces must make full-set inspection effortless
productionLessons.rule: One studio, all 4 directions x 7 actions, before/after per revised action, frame stepping, loop and transitions.
productionLessons.antiPattern: A folder of PNGs with a README telling the creator which files to open in which order.

productionLessons.title: Every package must pass a Technical Gate and a Visual/Artistic Review Gate
productionLessons.rule: Both gates, in that order, before anything is presented as ready. Passing one is not passing the other.
productionLessons.antiPattern: Shipping on the technical gate and letting the creator discover the anatomy problems.

productionLessons.title: Independent QA must inspect visual criteria, not only file counts and schemas
productionLessons.rule: QA reviews anatomy, perspective, silhouette, choreography and pixel cleanliness, and records what it could not judge.
productionLessons.antiPattern: An 'APPROVED' verdict built from recomputed hashes while explicitly declining to judge the art.

measured.measuredBy: Automated pixel, silhouette, and before/after verification over build b178422e1f7fc19f068c
measured.defeatBefore: standing height 112px to terminal height 21px, width 82 to 109: flattened strip
measured.defeatAfter: standing height 111-112px to terminal height 66px, width 87-90 to 119-120px, intermediate heights [112, 90, 86, 63, 66] (front) and [111, 91, 84, 67, 66] (back), terminal aspect ratio 1.80-1.82: progressive 5-stage volumetric collapse

pureWhitePixelsInAttackHeadBand.before: halo pixels around green head crown in frontal attacks

openItems: Explicit creator visual review required across all 4 directions x 7 actions in the interactive review studios.
Creator sign-off required before any promotion to CREATOR_APPROVED or future Unity integration task.

gateOrdering: TECHNICAL_GATE: validate, exportAseprite, hashes, coverage matrix
doesNotGrant: permission to change canonical art outside the declared scope
